name: Golden Barrel Products Honey Brook
old_description: For over 40 years, Golden Barrel has provided quality baking products with families and businesses across the country. As a family-owned company based in Lancaster County, Pennsylvania, we are proud to provide flavorful ingredients through our network of distributors nationwide.
about:
Golden Barrel traces its roots to 1934, when M. Simon Zook founded the Zook Molasses Company in Honey Brook, Pennsylvania, to supply local farmers with feeding molasses. The family-owned, woman-owned business expanded in 1980 when Zook's daughter Sally and her husband Larry Martin launched the Golden Barrel brand, adding cooking and baking supplies to the product line. Today the company operates two family-run facilities in Honey Brook and Leola, Pennsylvania.

The facilities produce a range of sweeteners and baking ingredients — molasses, syrups, sugars (dry and liquid), corn syrups, invert sugars, dextrose, cooking oils, baking mixes, and fondants. With rail-served capacity, Golden Barrel processes bulk sweeteners at scale, offering more than 200 custom liquid blends and over 45 retail-ready products. Operations include liquid and dry blending, warehousing, private labeling, and transportation, serving customers from retail bottles to bulk tanker loads.

The company serves baking, confectionery, snack, beverage, and food-service markets across the United States. Its customers include bakeries, food manufacturers, and distributors of all sizes, with products distributed nationwide through a network of wholesale and online channels.

Golden Barrel emphasizes its nearly 90-year heritage, family craftsmanship, and commitment to pure, natural ingredients. The business is certified by WBENC as a women's business enterprise and offers kosher-certified products, while maintaining community partnerships throughout Lancaster County.
